description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-based coffee chain with a location in Richmond's Number 1 Road corridor. As a café offering takeout, it can serve as a quick stop for cyclists passing through the area for hot drinks and light fare. The brand operates numerous locations across the Lower Mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to Blenz Coffee's online ordering platform (Auphan-powered), which rendered only navigation UI and no store-specific amenity or facility content, making website-based amenity verification impossible. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is used to confirm takeout. All other amenities remain null due to absence of evidence in either source.
concerns: Website URL points to an online ordering system (Auphan platform) rather than a brand or store information page; no amenity details could be verified from the website content.
No phone number present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open coffee chain location useful as a rest stop for touring cyclists; no grounds for exclusion.
